embeds.title: 🔴 Grafana GitHub Token Breach Led to Codebase Download
embeds.description:
Grafana disclosed that an unauthorized party obtained a GitHub token granting access to the company's environment and codebase. Grafana states no customer data or personal information was accessed and found no evidence of impact to customer systems. The attacker attempted extortion, but Grafana declined to pay the ransom. CoinbaseCartel claims responsibility according to reports from Hackmanac and Ransomware.live, though Grafana has not attributed the breach to any known threat actor.
**Sources:** thehackernews.com • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** none • **Access:** Compromised GitHub token
**Incident date:** unknown • **Confidence:** claim
